This script runs robustness checks on the Q17 bucket correlations from
script 14. Four model variants are compared:

- **Full**: all 28 tools (replicates script 14)
- **No Grammarly**: Grammarly excluded (passive inline correction tool;
  categorically different interaction model from generative prompting)
- **No ChatGPT**: ChatGPT excluded (tests whether findings are driven
  by a single dominant tool; ~90% ever-used rate)
- **No Grammarly + No ChatGPT**: both excluded simultaneously

Additionally:
- **Breadth score**: number of distinct tools with use_score >= 3 per
  participant (single predictor, no compositional dependency)
- **Mixed model**: use_score ~ factor_score + (1|tool) + (1|participant)

A comparison table is auto-generated showing rho shifts across all
four variants for every Bonferroni/BH survivor from script 14.

---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(knitr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(scales)
library(conflicted)
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
source("scoring_helpers.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

set.seed(42L)
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
script_dir <- "15_q17_robustness"
csv_dir    <- file.path(script_dir, "csv")
plot_dir   <- file.path(script_dir, "plots")

dir.create(csv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

min_corr_n <- 10L

# Tool names to exclude in sensitivity runs
# Grammarly: passive inline correction, different interaction model
# ChatGPT: ~90% ever-used, tests single-tool dominance
EXCLUDE_GRAMMARLY <- "Grammarly"  # adjust to exact tool_name string in your data
EXCLUDE_CHATGPT   <- "ChatGPT (including DALL-E) by OpenAI"  # adjust if needed

# Inputs
q17_long_file      <- file.path("09_q17_ai_use", "csv", "Q17_Responses_Long.csv")
factor_scores_file <- file.path("07_art_vs_all_factors_items", "csv", "Other_Instrument_Factor_Scores.csv")
factor_lookup_file <- file.path("07_art_vs_all_factors_items", "csv", "Factor_Lookup.csv")
all_items_file     <- file.path("07_art_vs_all_factors_items", "csv", "All_Items_Wide.csv")
item_lookup_file   <- file.path("07_art_vs_all_factors_items", "csv", "All_Item_Lookup.csv")
# Script 14 Bonferroni survivors - import for comparison table
s14_factors_file   <- file.path("14_q17_deeper_dive", "csv", "Q17_Proportions_vs_Factors_Correlations.csv")

required_files <- c(
  q17_long_file, factor_scores_file, factor_lookup_file,
  all_items_file, item_lookup_file, s14_factors_file
)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    glue(
      "Missing required inputs:\n- {paste(missing_files, collapse = '\n- ')}\n\n",
      "Run 07, 09, and 14 first."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
safe_spearman <- function(data, predictor, outcome) {
  dat <- data |>
    select(all_of(c(predictor, outcome))) |>
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x)))

  if (nrow(dat) < min_corr_n ||
      dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[predictor]]) < 2L ||
      dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[outcome]]) < 2L) {
    return(tibble(
      predictor = predictor,
      outcome   = outcome,
      n         = nrow(dat),
      rho       = NA_real_,
      p_value   = NA_real_,
      note      = "insufficient variation or sample size"
    ))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(dat[[predictor]], dat[[outcome]],
             method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    predictor = predictor,
    outcome   = outcome,
    n         = nrow(dat),
    rho       = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value   = test$p.value,
    note      = NA_character_
  )
}

adjust_p_within_metric <- function(df, metric_col = "q17_metric",
                                   p_col = "p_value") {
  df |>
    group_by(.data[[metric_col]]) |>
    mutate(
      p_bh          = p.adjust(.data[[p_col]], method = "BH"),
      p_bonferroni  = p.adjust(.data[[p_col]], method = "bonferroni")
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

# Build participant-level bucket metrics from long data
build_q17_dist <- function(long_df) {
  long_df |>
    group_by(participant_id) |>
    summarise(
      q17_tools_answered = n(),
      q17_n_1 = sum(use_score == 1L),
      q17_n_2 = sum(use_score == 2L),
      q17_n_3 = sum(use_score == 3L),
      q17_n_4 = sum(use_score == 4L),
      q17_n_5 = sum(use_score == 5L),
      q17_mean_use = mean(use_score),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      q17_p_1 = q17_n_1 / q17_tools_answered,
      q17_p_2 = q17_n_2 / q17_tools_answered,
      q17_p_3 = q17_n_3 / q17_tools_answered,
      q17_p_4 = q17_n_4 / q17_tools_answered,
      q17_p_5 = q17_n_5 / q17_tools_answered
    )
}

# Run all factor correlations for one model variant
run_factor_corrs <- function(dist_df, factor_df_base, factor_cols,
                             factor_lookup, q17_metric_lookup,
                             q17_metrics_prop) {
  df <- factor_df_base |>
    dplyr::select(participant_id, all_of(factor_cols)) |>
    inner_join(dist_df, by = "participant_id")

  crossing(
    q17_metric = q17_metrics_prop,
    factor     = factor_cols
  ) |>
    mutate(
      result = map2(factor, q17_metric,
                    ~ safe_spearman(df, .x, .y))
    ) |>
    pull(result) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    rename(factor = predictor, q17_metric = outcome) |>
    mutate(abs_r = abs(rho)) |>
    adjust_p_within_metric(metric_col = "q17_metric",
                           p_col = "p_value") |>
    left_join(factor_lookup,     by = "factor") |>
    left_join(q17_metric_lookup, by = "q17_metric") |>
    mutate(
      survives_bh          = !is.na(p_bh) & p_bh < 0.05,
      survives_bonferroni  = !is.na(p_bonferroni) & p_bonferroni < 0.05
    )
}
```

## Load Data

```{r load}
q17_long_raw <- readr::read_csv(q17_long_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id))

# Confirm tool column exists — needed for exclusions
if (!"tool" %in% names(q17_long_raw)) {
  stop(
    "Q17 long file missing 'tool' column. ",
    "Check column names: ", paste(names(q17_long_raw), collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

all_factor_scores <- readr::read_csv(factor_scores_file,
                                     show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id))

factor_lookup <- readr::read_csv(factor_lookup_file,
                                 show_col_types = FALSE)

all_item_wide <- readr::read_csv(all_items_file,
                                 show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id))

item_lookup <- readr::read_csv(item_lookup_file,

s14_factors <- readr::read_csv(s14_factors_file,
                               show_col_types = FALSE)

factor_cols      <- factor_lookup$factor
item_cols        <- item_lookup$item_col

q17_metric_lookup <- tribble(
  ~q17_metric,    ~q17_label,                  ~metric_type, ~bucket,
  "q17_n_1",      "Never heard (count)",        "count",      1L,
  "q17_n_2",      "Heard, never used (count)",  "count",      2L,
  "q17_n_3",      "Rarely use (count)",         "count",      3L,
  "q17_n_4",      "Sometimes use (count)",      "count",      4L,
  "q17_n_5",      "Often use (count)",          "count",      5L,
  "q17_p_1",      "Never heard (prop)",         "prop",       1L,
  "q17_p_2",      "Heard, never used (prop)",   "prop",       2L,
  "q17_p_3",      "Rarely use (prop)",          "prop",       3L,
  "q17_p_4",      "Sometimes use (prop)",       "prop",       4L,
  "q17_p_5",      "Often use (prop)",           "prop",       5L,
  "q17_mean_use", "Mean use (1–5)",             "summary",    NA_integer_
)

q17_metrics_prop <- q17_metric_lookup |>
  filter(metric_type %in% c("prop", "summary")) |>
  pull(q17_metric)

# Verify exclusion strings exist in data
tools_present <- unique(q17_long_raw$tool)
check_tool <- function(name, label) {
  if (!name %in% tools_present) {
    warning(glue(
      "{label} tool name '{name}' not found in data. ",
      "Check EXCLUDE_ strings in config. Available tools:\n",
      paste(sort(tools_present), collapse = "\n")
    ))
  }
}
check_tool(EXCLUDE_GRAMMARLY, "Grammarly")
check_tool(EXCLUDE_CHATGPT,   "ChatGPT")
```

## Build Four Model Variants

```{r build-variants}
q17_long_clean <- q17_long_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(participant_id), participant_id != "",
         !is.na(use_score), use_score %in% 1:5) |>
  mutate(
    participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
    use_score      = as.integer(use_score)
  )

# Four filtered long datasets
long_full    <- q17_long_clean
long_no_gram <- q17_long_clean |> filter(tool != EXCLUDE_GRAMMARLY)
long_no_cgpt <- q17_long_clean |> filter(tool != EXCLUDE_CHATGPT)
long_no_both <- q17_long_clean |>
  filter(!tool %in% c(EXCLUDE_GRAMMARLY, EXCLUDE_CHATGPT))

# Participant-level bucket distributions for each variant
dist_full    <- build_q17_dist(long_full)
dist_no_gram <- build_q17_dist(long_no_gram)
dist_no_cgpt <- build_q17_dist(long_no_cgpt)
dist_no_both <- build_q17_dist(long_no_both)

cat("Tools in full model:              ", n_distinct(long_full$tool),    "\n")
cat("Tools after dropping Grammarly:   ", n_distinct(long_no_gram$tool), "\n")
cat("Tools after dropping ChatGPT:     ", n_distinct(long_no_cgpt$tool), "\n")
cat("Tools after dropping both:        ", n_distinct(long_no_both$tool), "\n")
cat("Participants (all variants):      ", nrow(dist_full),                    "\n")
```

# Part A — Factor Correlations Across Four Variants

```{r factor-corrs-all-variants}
corrs_full    <- run_factor_corrs(dist_full,    all_factor_scores,
                                  factor_cols, factor_lookup,
                                  q17_metric_lookup, q17_metrics_prop) |>
  mutate(model = "Full")

corrs_no_gram <- run_factor_corrs(dist_no_gram, all_factor_scores,
                                  factor_cols, factor_lookup,
                                  q17_metric_lookup, q17_metrics_prop) |>
  mutate(model = "No Grammarly")

corrs_no_cgpt <- run_factor_corrs(dist_no_cgpt, all_factor_scores,
                                  factor_cols, factor_lookup,
                                  q17_metric_lookup, q17_metrics_prop) |>
  mutate(model = "No ChatGPT")

corrs_no_both <- run_factor_corrs(dist_no_both, all_factor_scores,
                                  factor_cols, factor_lookup,
                                  q17_metric_lookup, q17_metrics_prop) |>
  mutate(model = "No Grammarly + No ChatGPT")

all_factor_corrs <- bind_rows(
  corrs_full, corrs_no_gram, corrs_no_cgpt, corrs_no_both
)

write_csv(all_factor_corrs,
          file.path(csv_dir, "Robustness_Factor_Corrs_AllVariants.csv"))
```

## A1 — Rho Comparison Table (factor-level)

Rows = every factor × Q17 metric combination that survived Bonferroni
in at least one model variant. Columns = rho under each model.

```{r rho-comparison-table}
# Identify survivors across any model
survivors <- all_factor_corrs |>
  filter(survives_bonferroni) |>
  distinct(factor, q17_metric)

rho_comparison <- all_factor_corrs |>
  semi_join(survivors, by = c("factor", "q17_metric")) |>
  select(factor, display_label, q17_label, model, rho,
         survives_bh, survives_bonferroni) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = model,
    values_from = c(rho, survives_bonferroni),
    names_glue  = "{model}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Flag if rho changes direction or drops below BH threshold
    # when either tool is removed
    direction_flip = sign(`Full_rho`) != sign(`No ChatGPT_rho`) |
                     sign(`Full_rho`) != sign(`No Grammarly_rho`),
    chatgpt_sensitive = abs(`Full_rho` - `No ChatGPT_rho`) > 0.05,
    grammarly_sensitive = abs(`Full_rho` - `No Grammarly_rho`) > 0.05
  ) |>
  arrange(q17_label, display_label)

write_csv(rho_comparison,
          file.path(csv_dir, "Robustness_Rho_Comparison_Factors.csv"))

# Clean display version
rho_comparison |>
  select(
    `Q17 metric`  = q17_label,
    Factor        = display_label,
    `Full`                          = `Full_rho`,
    `No Grammarly`                  = `No Grammarly_rho`,
    `No ChatGPT`                    = `No ChatGPT_rho`,
    `No Grammarly + No ChatGPT`     = `No Grammarly + No ChatGPT_rho`,
    `ChatGPT sensitive`             = chatgpt_sensitive,
    `Grammarly sensitive`           = grammarly_sensitive,
    `Direction flip`                = direction_flip
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "Rho comparison across model variants (Bonferroni survivors only)")
```

## A2 — Dot plot: rho shift across variants

```{r rho-shift-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
plot_df <- all_factor_corrs |>
  semi_join(survivors, by = c("factor", "q17_metric")) |>
  mutate(
    label = paste0(display_label, " ~ ", q17_label),
    model = factor(model, levels = c(
      "Full",
      "No Grammarly",
      "No ChatGPT",
      "No Grammarly + No ChatGPT"
    ))
  )

p_shift <- ggplot(plot_df,
                  aes(x = rho, y = fct_reorder(label, rho),
                      color = model, shape = survives_bonferroni)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = label), color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Full"                          = "#444444",
    "No Grammarly"                  = "#4f79b7",
    "No ChatGPT"                    = "#c96b3b",
    "No Grammarly + No ChatGPT"     = "#8c6bb1"
  )) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Bonferroni p < .05", "FALSE" = "not significant"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Rho shift across model variants — Bonferroni survivors",
    subtitle = "Each line = one factor × Q17 metric pair; filled = Bonferroni significant",
    x        = "Spearman rho",
    y        = NULL,
    color    = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Robustness_Rho_Shift_Factors.png"),
  plot = p_shift, width = 11, height = 6,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

p_shift
```

# Part B — Breadth Score

Breadth = number of distinct tools per participant with use_score >= 3
(rarely, sometimes, or often use). Single continuous predictor — no
compositional dependency, no bucket sparsity issues.

```{r breadth-score}
breadth_df <- q17_long_clean |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(
    breadth_any_use     = sum(use_score >= 3L),
    breadth_regular_use = sum(use_score >= 4L),
    breadth_often       = sum(use_score == 5L),
    n_tools_answered    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

breadth_factor_df <- all_factor_scores |>
  inner_join(breadth_df, by = "participant_id")

cat("Participants with breadth data: ", nrow(breadth_factor_df), "\n")

breadth_summary <- breadth_df |>
  summarise(
    across(
      starts_with("breadth_"),
      list(mean = mean, median = median, sd = sd, max = max),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )

kable(t(breadth_summary), col.names = "value",
      caption = "Breadth score summary statistics")

write_csv(breadth_df, file.path(csv_dir, "Breadth_Scores_PerParticipant.csv"))
```

## B1 — Breadth vs Factor Scores

```{r breadth-factor-corrs}
breadth_metrics <- c("breadth_any_use", "breadth_regular_use", "breadth_often")

breadth_factor_corrs <- crossing(
  predictor = breadth_metrics,
  outcome   = factor_cols
) |>
  mutate(result = map2(predictor, outcome,
                       ~ safe_spearman(breadth_factor_df, .x, .y))) |>
  pull(result) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  group_by(predictor) |>
  mutate(
    p_bh         = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
    abs_r        = abs(rho)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(factor_lookup, by = c("outcome" = "factor")) |>
  mutate(
    survives_bh         = !is.na(p_bh) & p_bh < 0.05,
    survives_bonferroni = !is.na(p_bonferroni) & p_bonferroni < 0.05
  ) |>
  arrange(predictor, p_bonferroni, desc(abs_r))

write_csv(breadth_factor_corrs,
          file.path(csv_dir, "Breadth_vs_Factors_Correlations.csv"))

breadth_factor_corrs |>
  select(predictor, display_label, rho, p_bh, p_bonferroni,
         survives_bh, survives_bonferroni, n) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) |>
  kable(caption = "Breadth scores vs factor scores (Spearman rho)")
```

## B2 — Breadth vs Factor Scores: dot plot

```{r breadth-factor-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
p_breadth <- breadth_factor_corrs |>
  mutate(

      "breadth_regular_use" = "Regular use (≥ sometimes)",

    values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "BH p < .05", "FALSE" = "ns"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Breadth score vs factor scores",
    subtitle = "* BH < .05   ** Bonferroni < .05",
```

# Part C — Mixed Model

Predicts use_score from each factor score with random intercepts for
tool and participant. Accounts for the nested structure: multiple
tool-responses per participant, and multiple participants per tool.

Note: runs one model per factor score. Interpret fixed effect estimate
(not rho) — positive = higher factor score predicts higher use_score.

```{r mixed-models}
# Build long dataset joined with factor scores
mm_long <- q17_long_clean |>
  inner_join(
    all_factor_scores |>
      select(participant_id, all_of(factor_cols)),
    by = "participant_id"
  )

cat("Rows in mixed model dataset: ", nrow(mm_long), "\n")
cat("Participants:                ", n_distinct(mm_long$participant_id), "\n")
cat("Tools:                       ", n_distinct(mm_long$tool), "\n")

# Run one model per factor
mm_results <- map_dfr(factor_cols, function(fac) {
  formula_str <- glue("use_score ~ {fac} + (1 | tool) + (1 | participant_id)")

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = mm_long, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      factor    = fac,
      estimate  = NA_real_,
      se        = NA_real_,
      t_value   = NA_real_,
      p_value   = NA_real_,
      note      = "model failed to converge"
    ))
  }

  coef_tbl <- as.data.frame(summary(fit)$coefficients)
  row <- coef_tbl[fac, , drop = FALSE]

  tibble(
    factor   = fac,
    estimate = row[["Estimate"]],
    se       = row[["Std. Error"]],
    t_value  = row[["t value"]],
    p_value  = row[["Pr(>|t|)"]]
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    p_bh         = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
    abs_est      = abs(estimate),
    survives_bh         = !is.na(p_bh) & p_bh < 0.05,
    survives_bonferroni = !is.na(p_bonferroni) & p_bonferroni < 0.05
  ) |>
  left_join(factor_lookup, by = "factor") |>
  arrange(p_bonferroni, desc(abs_est))

write_csv(mm_results,
          file.path(csv_dir, "MixedModel_Factor_Results.csv"))

mm_results |>
  select(display_label, estimate, se, t_value,
         p_value, p_bh, p_bonferroni,
         survives_bh, survives_bonferroni) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) |>
  kable(caption = "Mixed model results: use_score ~ factor + (1|tool) + (1|participant)")
```

## C1 — Mixed model coefficient plot

```{r mm-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
p_mm <- mm_results |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  mutate(
    sig_label     = case_when(
      survives_bonferroni ~ "**",
      survives_bh         ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    ),
    display_label = fct_reorder(display_label, estimate),
    ci_lo = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    ci_hi = estimate + 1.96 * se
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = display_label,
             color = instrument, shape = survives_bh)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), hjust = -0.4, size = 4,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "IMI"            = "#4f79b7",
    "WritingEfficacy" = "#c96b3b",
    "AIReflection"   = "#5a9367",
    "BeliefsAboutAI" = "#8c6bb1"
  )) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "BH p < .05", "FALSE" = "ns"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Mixed model: factor score → AI tool use_score",
    subtitle = "Estimate = fixed effect of factor on use_score (1–5)  |  bars = 95% CI  |  * BH < .05   ** Bonferroni < .05",
    x        = "Estimate (fixed effect)",
    y        = NULL,
    color    = "Instrument"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "MixedModel_Factor_Coefficients.png"),
  plot = p_mm, width = 10, height = 5.5,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

p_mm
```

# Part D — Master Robustness Summary Table

Combines script 14 Bonferroni survivors with all robustness checks.
One row per finding; columns show rho/estimate across every method.

```{r master-summary}
# Script 14 survivors
s14_survivors <- s14_factors |>
  filter(survives_bonferroni) |>
  select(factor, q17_metric, display_label, q17_label,
         rho_s14 = rho, p_bonferroni_s14 = p_bonferroni)

# Robustness rhos for same pairs
robust_rhos <- all_factor_corrs |>
  semi_join(s14_survivors, by = c("factor", "q17_metric")) |>
  select(factor, q17_metric, model, rho) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = rho,
              names_prefix = "rho_")

# Breadth — pick best matching metric per survivor
# (use breadth_any_use as the broadest analog to mean_use)
breadth_rhos <- breadth_factor_corrs |>
  filter(predictor == "breadth_any_use") |>
  select(factor = outcome, rho_breadth = rho,
         p_bonferroni_breadth = p_bonferroni)

# Mixed model estimates
mm_rhos <- mm_results |>
  select(factor, mm_estimate = estimate,
         mm_p_bonferroni = p_bonferroni,
         mm_survives_bonferroni = survives_bonferroni)

master <- s14_survivors |>
  left_join(robust_rhos,   by = c("factor", "q17_metric")) |>
  left_join(breadth_rhos,  by = "factor") |>
  left_join(mm_rhos,       by = "factor") |>
  mutate(
    chatgpt_delta   = abs(rho_s14 - `rho_No ChatGPT`),
    grammarly_delta = abs(rho_s14 - `rho_No Grammarly`),
    robust_verdict  = case_when(
      chatgpt_delta > 0.10 & grammarly_delta > 0.10 ~
        "sensitive to both",
      chatgpt_delta > 0.10 ~
        "ChatGPT sensitive",
      grammarly_delta > 0.10 ~
        "Grammarly sensitive",
      TRUE ~ "robust"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(q17_label, display_label)

write_csv(master, file.path(csv_dir, "Master_Robustness_Summary.csv"))

master |>
  select(
    `Q17 metric`         = q17_label,
    Factor               = display_label,
    `S14 rho`            = rho_s14,
    `No Grammarly`       = `rho_No Grammarly`,
    `No ChatGPT`         = `rho_No ChatGPT`,
    `No Gram + No CGPT`  = `rho_No Grammarly + No ChatGPT`,
    `Breadth rho`        = rho_breadth,
    `MM estimate`        = mm_estimate,
    `Verdict`            = robust_verdict
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "Master robustness summary — script 14 Bonferroni survivors")
```
